SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyDefeat.en: Darn!\nI let that one get away!

SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyIntro.en: Hello, stranger!\pI can't tell if you're from the seas\nor mountains, but stop and chat.\pAll my POKéMON are from the sea.
SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyIntro.fr: Bonjour, étranger !\pJe ne sais pas si tu viens des mers\nou des montagnes, mais arrête-toi\let discute.\pTous mes POKéMON viennent de la\nmer.

SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyPostBattle.en: I was going to make you my\nassistant, too!
SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyPostBattle.fr: J'allais aussi faire de toi mon\nassistant !

SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipIntro.en: Matey, you're walking the plank if\nyou lose!
SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipIntro.fr: Moussaillon, tu passes à la planche\nsi tu perds !

SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipPostBattle.en: When we're out at sea, jellyfish\nPOKéMON sometimes drift by.
SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipPostBattle.fr: Quand on est en mer, des POKéMON\nméduses passent parfois à la\ldérive.
